name: Supine Hip External Rotation Stretch

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: Cornell Health Lower Extremity Range of Motion Protocol

steps: Lie comfortably on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Bring the soles of your feet together and slowly allow both knees to fall open to the sides toward the floor.
Rest your hands gently on your lower abdomen or alongside your body.
Feel a gentle, relaxing stretch through your inner thighs and groin.
Hold the position for 30 to 45 seconds while focusing on deep abdominal breathing.
coaching_cues: Place yoga blocks or pillows under your outer thighs if the stretch feels too intense on your groin.
Do not arch your lower back aggressively off the floor.
Relax your inner thighs completely with each exhalation.

sources.attribution: Cornell Health Lower Extremity Range of Motion Protocol
